name: maybole-mailbox-bridge
description: Connect Maybole to desktop AI clients. Draft creation is review-first and never sends email.
long_description: Technical Preview: connect Maybole with device pairing, choose an exact desktop mail account, create a safe test draft, and import confirmed batches as unsent drafts. Never sends. Includes account-discovery recovery and .eml fallback. Mac adapters use plain text and do not support attachments; classic Outlook Windows supports HTML and attachments. Live provider certification is incomplete.
